details: District_FloodImpact.csv, District_FloodedArea.csv, and DFSI.csv do not contain LGD district/state codes, preventing a fully identifier-based join.
Some district names repeat across source files and cannot be safely joined by district name alone without state or LGD identifiers.
Some district keys do not appear in every source needed for the reproduction or do not match any parsed flood event.
Rows with missing numeric components are preserved as missing and are not imputed.
Some event rows have missing district lists or district/code count mismatches after parsing comma-separated fields.
The event inventory state field may list multiple states per event and is not positionally aligned to each exploded district entry.
